parts.title: Passage 1
parts.article_title: The Guardian Newspaper’s Travel Photography Competition

paragraphs.text: The photo competition is back, giving you another chance to win an incredible trip to Swedish Lapland.
paragraphs.translation: 摄影比赛再次回归，为您提供了又一次机会，赢取一次前往瑞典拉普兰的绝妙旅行。

paragraphs.text: Do you have a camera and love travelling? If so, our annual photography competition run by the Travel section of The Guardian is for you. It's an opportunity for you to capture the essence of the journeys you make, whether far afield or close to home, and for us to showcase your work online. The winner of each month's competition will also see their shot mounted and displayed in the end-of-year exhibition for the public at The Guardian's offices in London. Once the exhibition is finished, each monthly winner will receive a framed copy of their shot to place with pride on their own wall.
paragraphs.translation:
你有相机并且热爱旅行吗？
如果是这样，那么由《卫报》旅游版主办的年度摄影比赛就是为你准备的。
这是一个让你捕捉旅行精髓的机会，无论你去远方还是家附近，也是让我们在线展示你作品的机会。
每月比赛的获胜者还将看到他们的作品被装裱并在《卫报》伦敦办公室的年度展览中向公众展示。
展览结束后，每位月度获胜者将收到一幅装裱好的作品副本，自豪地挂在自己家的墙上。

paragraphs.text: There will be a different theme for each month. Members of The Guardian travel writing team, and photographer Michael Ryan of Fotovue.com will judge the monthly entries and the overall winner.
paragraphs.translation:
每个月都会有一个不同的主题。
《卫报》旅行写作团队的成员以及Fotovue.com的摄影师迈克尔·瑞安将评选月度参赛作品和最终获胜者。

paragraphs.text: To enter you must be living in the UK from the time you submit your entry into the competition to the time you are selected as a winner. The competition is open to all photographers (both amateur and professional).
paragraphs.translation:
要参赛，你必须从提交参赛作品到被选为获胜者期间居住在英国。
比赛对所有摄影师（包括业余和专业）开放。

paragraphs.text: The overall winner (chosen from the 12 monthly winners) will go on an amazing four-night trip to Swedish Lapland. The host for this specialist holiday is Fredrik Broman, who has been a nature photographer for 21 years. Fredrik will assist the winner and other participants in photographing a wide variety of winter subjects. Each day has a specific focus. The trip includes winter light photography workshops, an image editing workshop, a night photography course, and an action photography workshop.
paragraphs.translation:
总冠军（从12位月度冠军中选出）将获得一次前往瑞典拉普兰地区为期四晚的精彩之旅。
此次特色假期的东道主是弗雷德里克·布罗曼，他从事自然摄影已有21年。
弗雷德里克将协助冠军及其他参与者拍摄多种冬季主题。
每天都有一个特定的重点。
此次旅行包括冬季光线摄影工作坊、图像编辑工作坊、夜间摄影课程以及动作摄影工作坊。

paragraphs.text: Included in the prize: return flights from the UK, four nights' accommodation with full board, cold weather clothing for the duration of the trip - thermal overalls, winter boots, gloves, hats and woollen socks - fully qualified wilderness guides, and instructors.
paragraphs.translation: 奖品包括：从英国出发的往返航班、四晚全食宿住宿、行程期间所需的保暖衣物（如保暖连体服、冬靴、手套、帽子和羊毛袜），以及完全合格的专业荒野向导和教练。

paragraphs.text: The overall winner will be required to write a report of the trip, and take accompanying photographs, which will be printed in the Travel section of The Guardian at a later date. The Guardian reserves the right, however, to modify your report and photos as necessary. Your name will of course appear with the article and photos.
paragraphs.translation:
总冠军需要撰写一份关于此次行程的报告，并拍摄配套照片，这些内容将在日后刊登于《卫报》的旅游版面。
然而，《卫报》保留根据需要修改你的报告和照片的权利。
你的名字当然会与文章和照片一同出现。

paragraphs.text: Running Headphones
paragraphs.translation: 跑步耳机

paragraphs.text: Listening to music on headphones makes running and even working out at the gym much more enjoyable. Here are some alternatives to choose from.
paragraphs.translation:
戴着耳机听音乐能让跑步，甚至是在健身房锻炼身体，变得更加愉悦。
以下是一些可供选择的替代产品。

paragraphs.text: A Plantronics Backbeat Fit
paragraphs.translation: A 缤特力 Backbeat Fit

paragraphs.text: These headphones are really tough so you don't need to worry about just throwing them into your bag before or after a workout. As well as providing reasonably clear sound they will also last a remarkable eight hours on a single charge.
paragraphs.translation:
这款耳机非常坚固，所以你无需担心在锻炼前后把它们扔进包里。
除了提供相当清晰的声音外，它们单次充电还能持续惊人的八小时。

paragraphs.text: B Sennheiser CX685 Sports
paragraphs.translation: B 森海塞尔 CX685 运动耳机

paragraphs.text: These headphones are impressively practical. Designed to fit firmly in your ear, however energetic you are, they're tight without being uncomfortable, and have a handy remote and a mic for phone calls. They will also resist some water being spilt on them.
paragraphs.translation:
这款耳机非常实用，令人印象深刻。
它们设计得能牢固贴合耳部，无论你运动多么剧烈，佩戴紧凑却不感到不适，还配有便捷的遥控器和用于通话的麦克风。
此外，它们还能承受少量溅水。

paragraphs.text: C Nokia WH-510 Coloud Pop
paragraphs.translation: C 诺基亚 WH-510 科洛德流行款

paragraphs.text: These stylish headphones have fantastic bass, giving you a bit of extra oomph when you run. They also have a tangle-free cable which avoids any time-consuming messing about before you set off on your run.
paragraphs.translation:
这些时尚耳机拥有出色的低音效果，为你在跑步时增添额外的动力。
它们还配有防缠绕线缆，避免你出发跑步前浪费时间去整理线缆。

paragraphs.text: D Sony NWz-W273S
paragraphs.translation: D 索尼 NWz-W273S

paragraphs.text: It's hard to imagine using any other headphones once you've tried these. As well as being wireless and waterproof at a depth of 2m, they even have a built-in MP3 player that can hold up to 1,000 songs. A charge provides up to an hour of playback.
paragraphs.translation:
一旦尝试过这些耳机，就很难想象再使用其他款式了。
除了无线和在2米深水下防水之外，它们甚至内置了一个可存储多达1000首歌曲的MP3播放器。
一次充电可提供长达一小时的播放时间。

paragraphs.text: E Betron B750S
paragraphs.translation: E 贝创B750S

paragraphs.text: If you're on a tight budget, it can always feel risky buying a bottom of the market pair of headphones, but with these you needn't worry. Not only do they provide fair sound quality, they also come with a pouch to keep them in.
paragraphs.translation:
如果你预算紧张，购买一副市场上最便宜级的耳机总感觉有风险，但有了这些耳机，你无需担心。
它们不仅提供了不错的音质，还附带了一个收纳袋来存放耳机。

paragraphs.text: F Happy Plugs
paragraphs.translation: F 快乐耳机

paragraphs.text: The sound quality on these is decent, although you're probably not going to be hugely impressed. They also come with a handy remote built into the cable to skip and pause songs with while you work out.
paragraphs.translation:
这些耳机音质尚可，尽管你可能不会感到特别惊艳。
它们还配有一个内置于线缆中的便捷遥控器，方便你在锻炼时跳过或暂停歌曲。

paragraphs.text: G Powerbeats 2
paragraphs.translation: G Powerbeats 2

paragraphs.text: If money is not an issue, then these are definitely worth considering. They make everything sound so crisp and they're so light and comfortable that it's easy to forget that you're even wearing them.
paragraphs.translation:
如果钱不是问题，那么这些耳机绝对值得考虑。
它们让所有声音都听起来如此清晰，而且它们非常轻便舒适，以至于你很容易忘记自己还戴着它们。

groups.instructions:
Questions 1 - 8
Do the following statements agree with the information given in Reading Passage 1?
Choose TRUE if the statement agrees with the information given in the text, choose FALSE if the statement contradicts the information, or choose NOT GIVEN if there is no information on this.

questions.prompt: This is the first year that The Guardian has run a travel photography competition.
questions.analysis: 题干称这是《卫报》首次举办旅行摄影比赛，但原文第一段明确指出“The photo competition is back”且为“annual photography competition”，说明该比赛是每年举办的，并非首次。因此题干与原文矛盾，答案为FALSE。
questions.reason: 原文明确指出比赛 'is back'，且为 'annual'，表明并非首次举办。
questions.location_analysis: 原文说摄影比赛再次回归（back），且是年度（annual）比赛，暗示不是第一年举办。所以FA...
questions.paraphrasing: first year -> back; travel photography competition -> annual photography competition
questions.keywords: first year, The Guardian, travel photography competition
evidence: The photo competition is back, giving you another chance to win an incredible trip to Swedish Lapland.

wrong_reasons.TRUE: 与原文信息矛盾，原文表明这不是第一次举办。
wrong_reasons.NOT GIVEN: 原文明确提到了相关信息，并非未提及。

questions.prompt: Any photograph for the competition must have been taken on an overseas trip.
questions.analysis: 题干声称参赛照片必须是在海外旅行中拍摄的，但原文第二段提到参赛者可以捕捉“whether far afield or close to home”的旅程，即无论远行还是近处均可，说明并不限于海外。因此题干与原文矛盾，答案为FALSE。
questions.reason: 原文 'whether far afield or close to home' 表明不限于海外旅行。
questions.location_analysis: 原文说照片可拍自远方或离家近处，并未限定必须海外。所以FALSE。
questions.paraphrasing: overseas trip -> far afield or close to home
evidence: It's an opportunity for you to capture the essence of the journeys you make, whether far afield or close to home, and for us to showcase your work online.

wrong_reasons.TRUE: 该选项与原文信息矛盾，因为原文可能允许非海外旅行拍摄的照片参赛。
wrong_reasons.NOT GIVEN: 该选项错误，因为原文明确否定了必须海外旅行的说法，信息明确存在。

questions.prompt: The end-of-year exhibition in London is free for the public to attend.
questions.analysis: 题干询问伦敦年终展览是否对公众免费开放，但原文仅说明展览“for the public at The Guardian's offices in London”，并未提及是否免费入场。由于缺乏相关信息，无法判断真假，因此答案为NOT GIVEN。
questions.reason: 未提及免费信息。
questions.location_analysis: 原文只说了“向公众展示”，未提是否免费入场。
questions.paraphrasing: free for the public to attend → displayed for the public
evidence: The winner of each month's competition will also see their shot mounted and displayed in the end-of-year exhibition for the public at The Guardian's offices in London.

wrong_reasons.TRUE: 原文未提及该展览是否免费对公众开放，因此不能判断为正确。
wrong_reasons.FALSE: 原文并未提供证据表明该展览收费或不对公众开放，因此不能判断为错误。

questions.prompt: The judging panel is made up of a group of journalists and a professionalphotographer.
questions.analysis: 题干提到评审团由一群记者和一位专业摄影师组成，原文第三段明确指出评委包括“The Guardian travel writing team”（即记者）和“photographer Michael Ryan of Fotovue.com”（专业摄影师），两者完全对应。因此答案为TRUE。
questions.reason: 原文评委包括记者和专业人士。
questions.location_analysis: 原文提到评委包括旅行写作团队（记者）和摄影师Michael Ryan。所以TRUE。
questions.paraphrasing: judging panel -> judge the monthly entries; journalists -> travel writing team; professional photographer -> photographer Michael Ryan
evidence: Members of The Guardian travel writing team, and photographer Michael Ryan of Fotovue.com will judge the monthly entries and the overall winner.

wrong_reasons.FALSE: 原文明确表示评审团由记者和摄影师组成，与题干一致，因此该选项错误。
wrong_reasons.NOT GIVEN: 题干信息在原文中明确给出，并非未提及，因此该选项错误。

questions.prompt: The trip to Swedish Lapland will only be offered to one winner.
questions.analysis: 题干称前往瑞典拉普兰的旅行只提供给一位获奖者，原文第五段明确说明“The overall winner (chosen from the 12 monthly winners) will go on...”，即从12位月度获奖者中选出唯一一位总冠军获得该旅行。因此答案为TRUE。
questions.reason: 原文明确 'The overall winner' 只有一人。
questions.location_analysis: 原文说总冠军（从12个月冠军中选出）将获得该旅行，即只有一位获胜者。所以TRUE。
questions.paraphrasing: only one winner -> the overall winner (chosen from the 12 monthly winners) will go on...
questions.keywords: trip to Swedish Lapland, only one winner
evidence: The overall winner (chosen from the 12 monthly winners) will go on an amazing four-night trip to Swedish Lapland.

wrong_reasons.FALSE: 该选项与原文中明确提及的信息相矛盾，原文说明只有一位获奖者。
wrong_reasons.NOT GIVEN: 该选项认为原文未提供相关信息，但原文已明确说明只有一位获奖者，因此属于信息已给出。

questions.prompt: Every activity on the trip is focused on improving photography techniques.
questions.analysis: 题干称旅行中的每一项活动都聚焦于提升摄影技巧，原文第五段列出的活动包括“winter light photography workshops, an image editing workshop, a night photography course, and an action photography workshop”，全部与摄影技术相关，且“Each day has a specific focus”。因此答案为TRUE。
questions.reason: 原文全部活动均为摄影相关。
questions.location_analysis: 原文列出每日活动均为摄影工作坊或课程，表明所有活动都聚焦摄影技术。所以TRUE。
questions.paraphrasing: every activity -> each day; improving photography techniques -> winter light photography workshops, image editing workshop, night photography course, action photography workshop
questions.keywords: every activity, focused on improving photography techniques
evidence: Each day has a specific focus. The trip includes winter light photography workshops, an image editing workshop, a night photography course, and an action photography workshop.

wrong_reasons.FALSE: 与原文明确提到的所有活动都专注于提升摄影技巧相矛盾。
wrong_reasons.NOT GIVEN: 原文已明确给出该信息，因此不是未提及。

questions.prompt: Anyone going on the trip may take some of the cold weather clothing home at the end of the trip.
questions.analysis: 题干称旅行者可在旅行结束后带走防寒衣物，但原文第六段仅说明这些衣物“for the duration of the trip”，即仅在旅行期间提供使用，并未说明可带走。因此题干信息与原文不符，答案为FALSE。
questions.reason: 原文 'for the duration of the trip' 暗示仅为旅行期间使用。
questions.location_analysis: 原文只提到服装包含在奖品中，但未说明结束后是否可以带走。所以FALSE。
questions.paraphrasing: take home -> included in the prize
evidence: Included in the prize: return flights from the UK, four nights' accommodation with full board, cold weather clothing for the duration of the trip - thermal overalls, winter boots, gloves, hats and woollen socks - fully qualified wilderness guides, and instructors.

wrong_reasons.TRUE: 与原文信息矛盾，原文明确表示不能带走这些衣物。
wrong_reasons.NOT GIVEN: 原文中有明确信息，并非未提及。

questions.prompt: Articles written about the trip may be changed before being published.
questions.analysis: 题干称关于旅行的文章可能在发表前被修改，原文第七段明确指出“The Guardian reserves the right... to modify your report and photos as necessary”，即报社有权根据需要修改文章和照片。因此答案为TRUE。
questions.reason: 原文 'reserves the right to modify' 对应 'changed'。
questions.location_analysis: 原文明确说明报纸有权修改报告和照片。所以TRUE。
questions.paraphrasing: changed before being published -> modify your report and photos as necessary
evidence: The Guardian reserves the right, however, to modify your report and photos as necessary.

wrong_reasons.FALSE: 原文明确提到文章可能被修改，与选项声称的未修改矛盾。
wrong_reasons.NOT GIVEN: 原文直接提及了修改的可能性，并非未提及相关信息。

groups.instructions:
Questions 9 - 14
Look at the seven reviews of headphones, A-G.
For which headphones are the following statements true?
Write the correct letter, A-G, in boxes 9-14 on your answer sheet.
NB You may use any letter more than once.

questions.prompt: These headphones would suit someone who doesn't mind spending a lot to get good quality.
questions.analysis: 题干描述的是适合愿意花大钱换取高品质耳机的人，G项（Powerbeats 2）开头即说“If money is not an issue, then these are definitely worth considering”，并强调音质“crisp”、佩戴轻盈舒适，完全符合“不介意高消费以获得高质量”的描述。因此答案为G。
questions.reason: 原文表明不差钱且音质好。
questions.location_analysis: G项开头 'If money is not an issue' 对应不介意花钱，且音质清脆。
questions.paraphrasing: doesn't mind spending a lot -> If money is not an issue; good quality -> sound so crisp
questions.keywords: doesn't mind spending a lot, good quality
evidence: If money is not an issue, then these are definitely worth considering. They make everything sound so crisp and they're so light and comfortable that it's easy to forget that you're even wearing them.

questions.prompt: The battery on these headphones has a surprisingly long life.
questions.analysis: 题干提到耳机电池续航出奇地长，A项（Plantronics Backbeat Fit）原文指出“they will also last a remarkable eight hours on a single charge”，其中“remarkable eight hours”直接对应“surprisingly long life”。因此答案为A。
questions.reason: 原文 'last a remarkable eight hours' 对应长电池寿命。
questions.location_analysis: A项原文提到单次充电可长达8小时，电池寿命出奇长。
questions.paraphrasing: battery -> a single charge; long life -> last a remarkable eight hours
evidence: As well as providing reasonably clear sound they will also last a remarkable eight hours on a single charge.

questions.prompt: It is possible to keep in contact with other people while using these headphones.
questions.analysis: 题干询问哪款耳机允许用户在使用时与他人保持联系，B项（Sennheiser CX685 Sports）明确提到“have a handy remote and a mic for phone calls”，说明具备通话功能，能实现与他人联络。因此答案为B。
questions.reason: 原文 'mic for phone calls' 对应保持联系。
questions.location_analysis: B项原文提到有麦克风可用于通话，即可与他人保持联系。
questions.paraphrasing: keep in contact -> mic for phone calls
questions.keywords: keep in contact with other people
evidence: Designed to fit firmly in your ear, however energetic you are, they're tight without being uncomfortable, and have a handy remote and a mic for phone calls.

questions.prompt: Although these headphones are cheaper than most, music sounds quite good through them.
questions.analysis: 题干描述的是价格便宜但音质不错的耳机，E项（Betron B750S）开头提到“If you're on a tight budget”且属于“bottom of the market”，同时指出“they provide fair sound quality”，正好对应“cheaper than most”和“music sounds quite good”。因此答案为E。
questions.reason: 原文 'tight budget' + 'fair sound quality' 对应便宜但音质好。
questions.location_analysis: E项原文提到预算紧张、低价但音质尚可。
questions.paraphrasing: cheaper than most -> on a tight budget / bottom of the market; music sounds quite good -> fair sound quality
questions.keywords: cheaper than most, music sounds quite good
evidence: If you're on a tight budget, it can always feel risky buying a bottom of the market pair of headphones, but with these you needn't worry. Not only do they provide fair sound quality, they also come with a pouch to keep them in.

questions.prompt: These headphones are very strong and do not require gentle handling.
questions.analysis: 题干称耳机非常坚固、无需小心对待，A项（Plantronics Backbeat Fit）原文说“These headphones are really tough so you don't need to worry about just throwing them into your bag”，其中“really tough”和随意丢进包里的描述直接对应“very strong”和“do not require gentle handling”。因此答案为A。
questions.reason: 原文 'really tough' 和 'just throwing them into your bag' 对应耐用。
questions.location_analysis: A项原文说耳机很坚固，无需担心随便扔进包里。
questions.paraphrasing: very strong -> really tough; do not require gentle handling -> just throwing them into your bag
questions.keywords: very strong, do not require gentle handling
evidence: These headphones are really tough so you don't need to worry about just throwing them into your bag before or after a workout.

questions.prompt: These headphones allow users to move around their playlist of music easily while they are exercising.
questions.analysis: 题干询问哪款耳机能让用户在锻炼时轻松操作播放列表，F项（Happy Plugs）提到“come with a handy remote built into the cable to skip and pause songs with while you work out”，其中“skip and pause songs”即指在运动中便捷控制音乐播放。因此答案为F。
questions.reason: 原文 'remote... to skip and pause songs while you work out' 对应。
questions.location_analysis: F项原文提到遥控可跳过和暂停歌曲，方便健身体验。
questions.paraphrasing: move around playlist -> skip and pause songs; while exercising -> while you work out
evidence: They also come with a handy remote built into the cable to skip and pause songs with while you work out.

parts.title: Passage 2
parts.article_title: A case study of a risk assessment for general office cleaning

paragraphs.text: A commercial cleaning service took on a new contract to clean an office complex. Before sending cleaning staff to the offices, the manager of the cleaning service carried out a risk assessment using guidance provided by the Health and Safety Executive (HSE).
paragraphs.translation:
一家商业清洁服务公司承接了一份新合同，负责清洁一座办公综合体。
在派遣清洁人员前往办公室之前，该清洁服务公司的经理根据英国健康与安全执行局提供的指导进行了一次风险评估。

paragraphs.text: To identify the hazards, the cleaning service manager visited the office complex and walked through the areas where cleaning staff would be working, noting things that might pose potential risks. Following this, he consulted the health and safety representatives of the cleaning service about these risks, taking into account the needs of any particular staff members, such as whether they were pregnant or aged under 18.
paragraphs.translation:
为了识别危害，清洁服务经理走访了办公楼群，并走遍了清洁人员将要工作的区域，记录下可能带来潜在风险的事物。
随后，他就这些风险咨询了清洁服务部门的健康与安全代表，并考虑到了任何特定工作人员的需求，例如他们是否怀孕或年龄在18岁以下。

paragraphs.text: In order to gather further information, he then had a meeting with the client company during which a number of issues were discussed. These included the client company's own standard of housekeeping, such as the immediate clearing up of spills and keeping walkways clear, as well as the action to be taken if a fire broke out. He also established what facilities and equipment would be available to the cleaners, including the amount of storage space available, as well as the availability of sinks and taps, etc. and agreed on a method of reporting near-miss accidents and risks discovered by cleaners (e.g. damaged floor tiles).
paragraphs.translation:
为了收集更多信息，他随后与客户公司召开了一次会议，期间讨论了许多问题。
这些包括客户公司自身的内务管理标准，例如立即清理溅洒物并保持走道畅通，以及火灾发生时应采取的行动。
他还确定了清洁工可使用的设施和设备，包括可用存储空间的数量，以及水槽和水龙头的可用性等，并商定了一种报告清洁工发现的未遂事故和风险（例如损坏的地砖）的方法。

paragraphs.text: Following the meeting, the manager created a risk assessment document. He wrote down who could be harmed by each risk or hazard identified and in what way, and he then described what controls, if any, were in existence to manage these hazards. The manager then compared these to the good practice guidance set out on the HSE’s website and identified any areas where improvement was needed.
paragraphs.translation:
会议结束后，经理创建了一份风险评估文件。
他写下了每项已识别的风险或危害可能伤害的人员及其方式，然后描述了目前存在哪些控制措施（如果有的话）来管理这些危害。
接着，经理将这些措施与英国健康与安全执行局网站上列出的良好实践指南进行了比较，并找出了任何需要改进的方面。

paragraphs.text: The manager discussed the findings with the cleaning staff, making sure they understood the risks of the job and how these risks would be monitored. One cleaner, whose first language was not English, had difficulty understanding this, so the manager arranged for translation to be done by a bilingual cleaner from another team. Finally, to ensure that all the cleaning staff had access to a copy of the risk assessment, the manager pinned a copy in the cupboard where cleaning equipment was kept.
paragraphs.translation:
经理与清洁人员讨论了调查结果，确保他们理解工作的风险以及这些风险将如何被监控。
一名母语非英语的清洁工理解起来有困难，因此经理安排由另一团队的双语清洁工进行翻译。
最后，为确保所有清洁人员都能获取一份风险评估文件，经理将一份副本钉在存放清洁设备的柜子里。

paragraphs.text: Preparing for a virtual job interview
paragraphs.translation: 准备虚拟求职面试

paragraphs.text: Businesses are always looking for new ways to increase efficiency and profits. For example, organisations often reduce costs by conducting virtual job interviews. The video or Skype interview benefits both interviewer and interviewee, especially when an applicant would otherwise need to travel far. Despite the convenience though, it poses unique challenges.
paragraphs.translation:
企业总是在寻找提高效率和利润的新方法。
例如，组织通常通过进行虚拟求职面试来降低成本。
视频或Skype面试对面试官和求职者都有利，尤其是当申请人原本需要长途出行时。
尽管方便，但它也带来了独特的挑战。

paragraphs.text: How a virtual interview is the same
paragraphs.translation: 虚拟面试的相同之处

paragraphs.text: The typical interview process usually entails multiple steps. First, there is screening, lasting about thirty minutes. Its purpose is to ensure candidates have the basic requirements. In the second interview, they're assessed for their technical skills and on whether they would fit the organisation.
paragraphs.translation:
典型的面试过程通常包含多个步骤。
首先，是筛选环节，时长大约30分钟。
其目的是确保候选人具备基本要求。
在第二轮面试中，他们会被评估技术技能以及是否适合该组织。

paragraphs.text: Virtual interviews follow the same steps so you'll need to focus on the same core topics. Identify what the critical topics are based on the job description and prepare to talk about them. If you can, gather inside information so you can impress interviewers with your knowledge.
paragraphs.translation:
虚拟面试遵循相同的步骤，因此你需要专注于相同的核心主题。
根据职位描述识别关键主题，并准备进行讨论。
如果可能，收集内部信息，以便用你的知识给面试官留下深刻印象。

paragraphs.text: How a virtual interview is different
paragraphs.translation: 虚拟面试有何不同

paragraphs.text: Normally, you travel somewhere for an interview. One advantage of that is that you aren't responsible for the place, whereas in a virtual interview you must ensure you have an appropriate location and appropriate equipment.
paragraphs.translation:
通常情况下，你会前往某个地点参加面试。
这样做的一个好处是你无需对面试场所负责，而在虚拟面试中，你必须确保自己拥有合适的场地和适当的设备。

paragraphs.text: Modern technology is great when it works, but a pain when it doesn't. So, it's wise to check you can operate your webcam, especially if you don't use it often. Test the headset too and find out how intelligible your voice sounds. It's also wise to establish what software the interviewer is going to work with and give it a trial run.
paragraphs.translation:
现代技术在正常工作时很出色，但出现故障时则令人烦恼。
因此，明智的做法是检查你是否能操作网络摄像头，特别是当你不经常使用它时。
也要测试耳机，并弄清楚你的声音有多清晰可辨。
同样明智的是，确认面试官将使用什么软件，并进行一次试用。

paragraphs.text: Probably the biggest problem in a virtual interview is what the camera can see. You want the interviewer to see you as a professional. Having a messy or cluttered room behind you won't help you achieve this image—a clear white background is usually a safe bet.
paragraphs.translation:
虚拟面试中最大的问题可能在于摄像头所能拍摄到的画面。
你希望面试官将你视为一名专业人士。
身后杂乱无章的房间无助于塑造这一形象——通常，干净的白色背景是一个稳妥的选择。

paragraphs.text: The most important part of your preparation is to run through everything first as best you can. Have a friend conduct a rehearsal with you before the big day. This will help you know how to behave in front of the camera.
paragraphs.translation:
你准备工作中最重要的部分是尽可能先将所有流程演练一遍。
在重要日子到来之前，请一位朋友与你进行一场预演。
这将帮助你了解如何在镜头前表现得体。

paragraphs.text: All things considered, though, virtual interviews should be treated like any other type of interview. Being at home requires as much preparation as a traditional interview. If you follow the steps mentioned above, you have every chance of getting the job you want. Good luck!
paragraphs.translation:
不过，综合考虑下来，虚拟面试应与其他类型的面试一视同仁。
在家面试需要的准备量与传统面试一样多。
如果你遵循上述步骤，就很有可能获得心仪的工作。
祝你好运！

parts.source_article_title: A case study of a risk assessment for general office cleaning

sentence_translations.sentence: A commercial cleaning service took on a new contract to clean an office complex.
sentence_translations.translation: 一家商业清洁服务公司承接了一份新合同，负责清洁一座办公综合体。

sentence_translations.sentence: Before sending cleaning staff to the offices, the manager of the cleaning service carried out a risk assessment using guidance provided by the Health and Safety Executive (HSE).
sentence_translations.translation: 在派遣清洁人员前往办公室之前，该清洁服务公司的经理根据英国健康与安全执行局提供的指导进行了一次风险评估。

sentence_translations.sentence: To identify the hazards, the cleaning service manager visited the office complex and walked through the areas where cleaning staff would be working, noting things that might pose potential risks.
sentence_translations.translation: 为了识别危害，清洁服务经理走访了办公楼群，并走遍了清洁人员将要工作的区域，记录下可能带来潜在风险的事物。

sentence_translations.sentence: Following this, he consulted the health and safety representatives of the cleaning service about these risks, taking into account the needs of any particular staff members, such as whether they were pregnant or aged under 18.
sentence_translations.translation: 随后，他就这些风险咨询了清洁服务部门的健康与安全代表，并考虑到了任何特定工作人员的需求，例如他们是否怀孕或年龄在18岁以下。

sentence_translations.sentence: In order to gather further information, he then had a meeting with the client company during which a number of issues were discussed.
sentence_translations.translation: 为了收集更多信息，他随后与客户公司召开了一次会议，期间讨论了许多问题。

sentence_translations.sentence: These included the client company's own standard of housekeeping, such as the immediate clearing up of spills and keeping walkways clear, as well as the action to be taken if a fire broke out.
sentence_translations.translation: 这些包括客户公司自身的内务管理标准，例如立即清理溅洒物并保持走道畅通，以及火灾发生时应采取的行动。

sentence_translations.sentence: He also established what facilities and equipment would be available to the cleaners, including the amount of storage space available, as well as the availability of sinks and taps, etc. and agreed on a method of reporting near-miss accidents and risks discovered by cleaners (e.g. damaged floor tiles).
sentence_translations.translation: 他还确定了清洁工可使用的设施和设备，包括可用存储空间的数量，以及水槽和水龙头的可用性等，并商定了一种报告清洁工发现的未遂事故和风险（例如损坏的地砖）的方法。

sentence_translations.sentence: Following the meeting, the manager created a risk assessment document.
sentence_translations.translation: 会议结束后，经理创建了一份风险评估文件。

sentence_translations.sentence: He wrote down who could be harmed by each risk or hazard identified and in what way, and he then described what controls, if any, were in existence to manage these hazards.
sentence_translations.translation: 他写下了每项已识别的风险或危害可能伤害的人员及其方式，然后描述了目前存在哪些控制措施（如果有的话）来管理这些危害。

sentence_translations.sentence: The manager then compared these to the good practice guidance set out on the HSE’s website and identified any areas where improvement was needed.
sentence_translations.translation: 接着，经理将这些措施与英国健康与安全执行局网站上列出的良好实践指南进行了比较，并找出了任何需要改进的方面。

sentence_translations.sentence: The manager discussed the findings with the cleaning staff, making sure they understood the risks of the job and how these risks would be monitored.
sentence_translations.translation: 经理与清洁人员讨论了调查结果，确保他们理解工作的风险以及这些风险将如何被监控。

sentence_translations.sentence: One cleaner, whose first language was not English, had difficulty understanding this, so the manager arranged for translation to be done by a bilingual cleaner from another team.
sentence_translations.translation: 一名母语非英语的清洁工理解起来有困难，因此经理安排由另一团队的双语清洁工进行翻译。

sentence_translations.sentence: Finally, to ensure that all the cleaning staff had access to a copy of the risk assessment, the manager pinned a copy in the cupboard where cleaning equipment was kept.
sentence_translations.translation: 最后，为确保所有清洁人员都能获取一份风险评估文件，经理将一份副本钉在存放清洁设备的柜子里。

sentence_translations.sentence: Preparing for a virtual job interview
sentence_translations.translation: 准备虚拟求职面试

sentence_translations.sentence: Businesses are always looking for new ways to increase efficiency and profits.
sentence_translations.translation: 企业总是在寻找提高效率和利润的新方法。

sentence_translations.sentence: For example, organisations often reduce costs by conducting virtual job interviews.
sentence_translations.translation: 例如，组织通常通过进行虚拟求职面试来降低成本。

sentence_translations.sentence: The video or Skype interview benefits both interviewer and interviewee, especially when an applicant would otherwise need to travel far.
sentence_translations.translation: 视频或Skype面试对面试官和求职者都有利，尤其是当申请人原本需要长途出行时。

sentence_translations.sentence: Despite the convenience though, it poses unique challenges.
sentence_translations.translation: 尽管方便，但它也带来了独特的挑战。

sentence_translations.sentence: How a virtual interview is the same
sentence_translations.translation: 虚拟面试的相同之处

sentence_translations.sentence: The typical interview process usually entails multiple steps.
sentence_translations.translation: 典型的面试过程通常包含多个步骤。

sentence_translations.sentence: First, there is screening, lasting about thirty minutes.
sentence_translations.translation: 首先，是筛选环节，时长大约30分钟。

sentence_translations.sentence: Its purpose is to ensure candidates have the basic requirements.
sentence_translations.translation: 其目的是确保候选人具备基本要求。

sentence_translations.sentence: In the second interview, they're assessed for their technical skills and on whether they would fit the organisation.
sentence_translations.translation: 在第二轮面试中，他们会被评估技术技能以及是否适合该组织。

sentence_translations.sentence: Virtual interviews follow the same steps so you'll need to focus on the same core topics.
sentence_translations.translation: 虚拟面试遵循相同的步骤，因此你需要专注于相同的核心主题。

sentence_translations.sentence: Identify what the critical topics are based on the job description and prepare to talk about them.
sentence_translations.translation: 根据职位描述识别关键主题，并准备进行讨论。

sentence_translations.sentence: If you can, gather inside information so you can impress interviewers with your knowledge.
sentence_translations.translation: 如果可能，收集内部信息，以便用你的知识给面试官留下深刻印象。

sentence_translations.sentence: How a virtual interview is different
sentence_translations.translation: 虚拟面试有何不同

sentence_translations.sentence: Normally, you travel somewhere for an interview.
sentence_translations.translation: 通常情况下，你会前往某个地点参加面试。

sentence_translations.sentence: One advantage of that is that you aren't responsible for the place, whereas in a virtual interview you must ensure you have an appropriate location and appropriate equipment.
sentence_translations.translation: 这样做的一个好处是你无需对面试场所负责，而在虚拟面试中，你必须确保自己拥有合适的场地和适当的设备。

sentence_translations.sentence: Modern technology is great when it works, but a pain when it doesn't.
sentence_translations.translation: 现代技术在正常工作时很出色，但出现故障时则令人烦恼。

sentence_translations.sentence: So, it's wise to check you can operate your webcam, especially if you don't use it often.
sentence_translations.translation: 因此，明智的做法是检查你是否能操作网络摄像头，特别是当你不经常使用它时。

sentence_translations.sentence: Test the headset too and find out how intelligible your voice sounds.
sentence_translations.translation: 也要测试耳机，并弄清楚你的声音有多清晰可辨。

sentence_translations.sentence: It's also wise to establish what software the interviewer is going to work with and give it a trial run.
sentence_translations.translation: 同样明智的是，确认面试官将使用什么软件，并进行一次试用。

sentence_translations.sentence: Probably the biggest problem in a virtual interview is what the camera can see.
sentence_translations.translation: 虚拟面试中最大的问题可能在于摄像头所能拍摄到的画面。

sentence_translations.sentence: You want the interviewer to see you as a professional.
sentence_translations.translation: 你希望面试官将你视为一名专业人士。

sentence_translations.sentence: Having a messy or cluttered room behind you won't help you achieve this image—a clear white background is usually a safe bet.
sentence_translations.translation: 身后杂乱无章的房间无助于塑造这一形象——通常，干净的白色背景是一个稳妥的选择。

sentence_translations.sentence: The most important part of your preparation is to run through everything first as best you can.
sentence_translations.translation: 你准备工作中最重要的部分是尽可能先将所有流程演练一遍。

sentence_translations.sentence: Have a friend conduct a rehearsal with you before the big day.
sentence_translations.translation: 在重要日子到来之前，请一位朋友与你进行一场预演。

sentence_translations.sentence: This will help you know how to behave in front of the camera.
sentence_translations.translation: 这将帮助你了解如何在镜头前表现得体。

sentence_translations.sentence: All things considered, though, virtual interviews should be treated like any other type of interview.
sentence_translations.translation: 不过，综合考虑下来，虚拟面试应与其他类型的面试一视同仁。

sentence_translations.sentence: Being at home requires as much preparation as a traditional interview.
sentence_translations.translation: 在家面试需要的准备量与传统面试一样多。

sentence_translations.sentence: If you follow the steps mentioned above, you have every chance of getting the job you want.
sentence_translations.translation: 如果你遵循上述步骤，就很有可能获得心仪的工作。

sentence_translations.sentence: Good luck!
sentence_translations.translation: 祝你好运！

paragraphs.text: Does jazz music offer lessons for today's leaders?
paragraphs.translation: 爵士乐能为当今的领导者提供经验教训吗？

paragraphs.text: A

Ever since management expert Peter Drucker compared the job of Chief Executive Officer to that of an orchestra conductor, the business world has been exploring comparisons and inspirations from the world of music. Now Warwick Business School Professors Deniz Ucbasaran and Andy Lockett are hitting all the right notes with their study of famous jazz musicians, Leading Entrepreneurial Teams: Insights From Jazz, providing some essential insights for entrepreneurial team leaders.
paragraphs.translation:
自从管理专家彼得·德鲁克将首席执行官的工作比作管弦乐队指挥以来，商界一直在探索来自音乐领域的类比和灵感。
如今，华威商学院的教授德尼兹·乌奇巴萨兰和安迪·洛克特通过对著名爵士乐音乐家的研究，切中了要害，其著作《领导创业团队：来自爵士乐的启示》为创业团队领导者提供了一些重要的见解。

paragraphs.text: Ucbasaran and Lockett (together with Durham Business School Professor Michael Humphries) chose jazz for a number of reasons. For a start, jazz bands are synonymous with creativity, improvisation and innovation, all essential ingredients for entrepreneurship. Jazz groups and their members often operate in uncertain and dynamic environments, characterised by rapid change. Yet through collective endeavour many jazz bands find their own structure and harmony and become profitable enterprises - both creatively and commercially.
paragraphs.translation:
Ucbasaran 和 Lockett（与杜伦商学院教授 Michael Humphries 一起）选择爵士乐作为研究对象，原因有很多。
首先，爵士乐队是创造力、即兴发挥和创新精神的代名词，这些都是创业精神的重要组成部分。
爵士乐队及其成员通常在充满不确定性、动态变化且以快速变革为特征的环境中运作。
然而，通过集体努力，许多爵士乐队找到了自己的结构和和谐，并成为既具有创造性又具有商业价值的盈利性企业。

paragraphs.text: B

The authors decided to focus on three of the best known names in jazz - Duke Ellington, Miles Davis and Art Blakey. American composer Duke Ellington was a pioneering jazz orchestra leader from the 1920s through to the 1970s. Trumpet player Miles Davis was instrumental in the development of a number of new jazz styles, including bebop and jazz fusion. Jazz drummer Arthur 'Art' Blakey became famous as the leader of his band the Jazz Messengers.
paragraphs.translation:
作者决定重点关注爵士乐界三位最著名的人物——杜克·埃林顿、迈尔斯·戴维斯和阿特·布莱基。
美国作曲家杜克·埃林顿是从20世纪20年代到70年代的开创性爵士管弦乐队领袖。
小号手迈尔斯·戴维斯在多种新爵士风格的演变中起到了关键作用，包括比波普和爵士融合乐。
爵士鼓手亚瑟·“阿特”·布莱基以其领导的“爵士信使”乐队而闻名。

paragraphs.text: The research focused on the way that these jazz greats created and ran their musical enterprises. In particular, Ucbasaran and Lockett focused on three specific areas of leadership activity: team formation, team coordination and team turnover.
paragraphs.translation:
这项研究聚焦于这些爵士乐大师创建和运营其音乐事业的方式。
具体而言，Ucbasaran 和 Lockett 关注了领导活动的三个特定方面：团队组建、团队协调和团队更替。

paragraphs.text: There were strong similarities in the processes the band leaders used to assemble their diverse teams of talent. In particular, they looked for musicians with a different sound or way of playing, one that was unique to that band member and would improve the overall sound of the band. That feature was as much bound up with the personality of the individual musician as it was to do with their technical proficiency.
paragraphs.translation:
乐队领袖在组建他们多元化的才华团队时所采用的过程存在显著的相似性。
特别是，他们寻找具有不同音色或演奏方式的音乐家，这种独特性属于该乐队成员，并能提升乐队的整体音效。
这一特质既与个别音乐家的个性息息相关，也与他们的技术熟练程度密不可分。

paragraphs.text: C

But disparate teams, many different personalities, and high levels of creativity are a recipe for group conflict. And, sure enough, there was plenty of dysfunctional conflict and disruptive clashes of egos and personalities evident in the jazz ensembles. Traditional team leadership theory suggests that to get the best team performance the leader should foster conflict that is productive in its effects, while minimising destructive conflict. But this is difficult when the sources of productive and destructive conflict are the same; that is, differences in personality and thinking. So how do leaders deal with destructive conflict? It didn't seem to bother the likes of Ellington, Davis and Blakey. Their attitude was 'the music comes first'. The moments of musical genius when everything came together excused minor problems such as if individuals occasionally turned up late for practice, or stepped out of a performance for a quick snack.
paragraphs.translation:
然而，由不同成员组成的团队、众多迥异的个性以及高度的创造力，往往会造成团队冲突。
果然，爵士乐团中明显存在大量功能失调的冲突以及自我与个性的破坏性碰撞。
传统的团队领导理论认为，为了获得最佳的团队表现，领导者应鼓励具有积极效果的冲突，同时最大限度地减少破坏性冲突。
但当建设性冲突与破坏性冲突的根源相同（即个性与思维的差异）时，这一点很难做到。
那么领导者如何处理破坏性冲突呢？
这似乎并没有困扰艾灵顿、戴维斯和布莱基这样的人。
他们的态度是‘音乐至上’。
当一切融为一体时展现出的音乐天才时刻，使得诸如个别成员偶尔排练迟到、或在演出中途溜出去吃点零食之类的小问题变得情有可原。

paragraphs.text: D

Teams must coordinate their behaviour and action to achieve an outcome. The team leader can assume a number of different roles when helping the team achieve its objectives. Some leaders are very directive, detailing what tasks they want team members to perform, and how they want them to go about those tasks.
paragraphs.translation:
团队必须协调其行为和行动才能达成成果。
团队领导在帮助团队实现目标时可以扮演多种不同的角色。
有些领导非常指令性强，详细说明他们希望团队成员执行哪些任务，以及希望他们如何开展这些任务。

paragraphs.text: But that was not the approach Ellington, Davis and Blakey adopted. Instead, these leaders acted more as facilitators, empowering the musicians to collectively coordinate their behaviour and action to produce the desired outcome. As Ucbasaran and Lockett note, Miles Davis discouraged band members from rehearsing in case it led to musical clichés from over-practice. Similarly, he often asked his musicians to play a piece in an unusual key, so they did not rely on learned fingering patterns. The performers were not left entirely to their own devices though. All three leaders created a general framework within which team members could work, providing guidance but also the freedom to explore, express and make mistakes.
paragraphs.translation:
但这并不是埃林顿、戴维斯和布莱基所采用的方法。
相反，这些领导者更像促进者，授权音乐家们共同协调自身的行为和行动，以产生理想的结果。
正如乌克巴萨兰和洛基特所指出的，迈尔斯·戴维斯不鼓励乐队成员排练，以防过度练习导致音乐上的陈词滥调。
同样，他经常要求他的音乐家们用不寻常的调式演奏一首曲子，使他们不依赖于习得的指法模式。
不过，表演者并非完全放任自流。
三位领导者都建立了一个总体的框架，团队成员可以在其中工作，既提供指导，也给予探索、表达和犯错的自由。

paragraphs.text: E

The third aspect of leadership behaviour that Ucbasaran and her colleagues looked at was managing team turnover - people joining and leaving the team. in the jazz ensembles studied, musicians joined and left on a regular basis. Yet the high turnover of team members, despite the resulting loss of knowledge and skills, was seen in a positive light. That was partly because of the advantages of getting a fresh shot of knowledge, ideas and creativity when new members joined.
paragraphs.translation:
Ucbasaran 及其同事研究的领导行为的第三个方面是管理团队更替——即团队成员的加入与离开。
在所研究的爵士乐团中，音乐家们定期加入和离开。
然而，尽管团队成员的频繁更替导致了知识和技能的流失，这仍被以积极的眼光看待。
这部分是因为新成员加入时带来的新知识、新想法和新创造力的优势。

paragraphs.text: A common reason for the jazz musicians leaving was that they felt sufficiently qualified to go and run another band. The three band leaders were understanding about this, particularly as it was a process they had also been through. In some cases, in particular with Art Blakey, they actively encouraged and coached team members to become leaders. As the jazz icons Ellington, Davis and Blakey would no doubt agree, there is no magic score that if followed note by note will make you a great leader of creative talent. However, take an entrepreneur, a few cues from the aforementioned jazz trio, mix in a little improvisation, and you are more likely to hear the sweet sound of success. As Louis Armstrong once sang: 'Now that's jazz'.
paragraphs.translation:
爵士乐手离开的一个常见原因是他们感到自己足够有资格去经营另一支乐队。
三位乐队领袖对此表示理解，尤其是因为这也是他们曾经经历过的过程。
在某些情况下，特别是阿特·布雷基，他们积极鼓励并指导团队成员成为领导者。
正如爵士乐偶像埃林顿、戴维斯和布雷基无疑会认同的那样，并不存在一个神奇的乐谱，只要逐音遵循就能让你成为创造性人才的伟大领导者。
然而，如果一位企业家从上述爵士三人组中汲取一些经验，再融入一点即兴发挥，你就更有可能听到成功的甜美声音。
正如路易斯·阿姆斯特朗曾唱道：'这就是爵士乐'。

sentence_translations.sentence: Does jazz music offer lessons for today's leaders?

sentence_translations.sentence: Ever since management expert Peter Drucker compared the job of Chief Executive Officer to that of an orchestra conductor, the business world has been exploring comparisons and inspirations from the world of music.
sentence_translations.translation: 自从管理专家彼得·德鲁克将首席执行官的工作比作管弦乐队指挥以来，商界一直在探索来自音乐领域的类比和灵感。

sentence_translations.sentence: Now Warwick Business School Professors Deniz Ucbasaran and Andy Lockett are hitting all the right notes with their study of famous jazz musicians, Leading Entrepreneurial Teams: Insights From Jazz, providing some essential insights for entrepreneurial team leaders.
sentence_translations.translation: 如今，华威商学院的教授德尼兹·乌奇巴萨兰和安迪·洛克特通过对著名爵士乐音乐家的研究，切中了要害，其著作《领导创业团队：来自爵士乐的启示》为创业团队领导者提供了一些重要的见解。

sentence_translations.sentence: Ucbasaran and Lockett (together with Durham Business School Professor Michael Humphries) chose jazz for a number of reasons.
sentence_translations.translation: Ucbasaran 和 Lockett（与杜伦商学院教授 Michael Humphries 一起）选择爵士乐作为研究对象，原因有很多。

sentence_translations.sentence: For a start, jazz bands are synonymous with creativity, improvisation and innovation, all essential ingredients for entrepreneurship.
sentence_translations.translation: 首先，爵士乐队是创造力、即兴发挥和创新精神的代名词，这些都是创业精神的重要组成部分。

sentence_translations.sentence: Jazz groups and their members often operate in uncertain and dynamic environments, characterised by rapid change.
sentence_translations.translation: 爵士乐队及其成员通常在充满不确定性、动态变化且以快速变革为特征的环境中运作。

sentence_translations.sentence: Yet through collective endeavour many jazz bands find their own structure and harmony and become profitable enterprises - both creatively and commercially.
sentence_translations.translation: 然而，通过集体努力，许多爵士乐队找到了自己的结构和和谐，并成为既具有创造性又具有商业价值的盈利性企业。

sentence_translations.sentence: The authors decided to focus on three of the best known names in jazz - Duke Ellington, Miles Davis and Art Blakey.
sentence_translations.translation: 作者决定重点关注爵士乐界三位最著名的人物——杜克·埃林顿、迈尔斯·戴维斯和阿特·布莱基。

sentence_translations.sentence: American composer Duke Ellington was a pioneering jazz orchestra leader from the 1920s through to the 1970s.
sentence_translations.translation: 美国作曲家杜克·埃林顿是从20世纪20年代到70年代的开创性爵士管弦乐队领袖。

sentence_translations.sentence: Trumpet player Miles Davis was instrumental in the development of a number of new jazz styles, including bebop and jazz fusion.
sentence_translations.translation: 小号手迈尔斯·戴维斯在多种新爵士风格的演变中起到了关键作用，包括比波普和爵士融合乐。

sentence_translations.sentence: Jazz drummer Arthur 'Art' Blakey became famous as the leader of his band the Jazz Messengers.
sentence_translations.translation: 爵士鼓手亚瑟·“阿特”·布莱基以其领导的“爵士信使”乐队而闻名。

sentence_translations.sentence: The research focused on the way that these jazz greats created and ran their musical enterprises.
sentence_translations.translation: 这项研究聚焦于这些爵士乐大师创建和运营其音乐事业的方式。

sentence_translations.sentence: In particular, Ucbasaran and Lockett focused on three specific areas of leadership activity: team formation, team coordination and team turnover.
sentence_translations.translation: 具体而言，Ucbasaran 和 Lockett 关注了领导活动的三个特定方面：团队组建、团队协调和团队更替。

sentence_translations.sentence: There were strong similarities in the processes the band leaders used to assemble their diverse teams of talent.
sentence_translations.translation: 乐队领袖在组建他们多元化的才华团队时所采用的过程存在显著的相似性。

sentence_translations.sentence: In particular, they looked for musicians with a different sound or way of playing, one that was unique to that band member and would improve the overall sound of the band.
sentence_translations.translation: 特别是，他们寻找具有不同音色或演奏方式的音乐家，这种独特性属于该乐队成员，并能提升乐队的整体音效。

sentence_translations.sentence: That feature was as much bound up with the personality of the individual musician as it was to do with their technical proficiency.
sentence_translations.translation: 这一特质既与个别音乐家的个性息息相关，也与他们的技术熟练程度密不可分。

sentence_translations.sentence: But disparate teams, many different personalities, and high levels of creativity are a recipe for group conflict.
sentence_translations.translation: 然而，由不同成员组成的团队、众多迥异的个性以及高度的创造力，往往会造成团队冲突。

sentence_translations.sentence: And, sure enough, there was plenty of dysfunctional conflict and disruptive clashes of egos and personalities evident in the jazz ensembles.
sentence_translations.translation: 果然，爵士乐团中明显存在大量功能失调的冲突以及自我与个性的破坏性碰撞。

sentence_translations.sentence: Traditional team leadership theory suggests that to get the best team performance the leader should foster conflict that is productive in its effects, while minimising destructive conflict.
sentence_translations.translation: 传统的团队领导理论认为，为了获得最佳的团队表现，领导者应鼓励具有积极效果的冲突，同时最大限度地减少破坏性冲突。

sentence_translations.sentence: But this is difficult when the sources of productive and destructive conflict are the same; that is, differences in personality and thinking.
sentence_translations.translation: 但当建设性冲突与破坏性冲突的根源相同（即个性与思维的差异）时，这一点很难做到。

sentence_translations.sentence: So how do leaders deal with destructive conflict?
sentence_translations.translation: 那么领导者如何处理破坏性冲突呢？

sentence_translations.sentence: It didn't seem to bother the likes of Ellington, Davis and Blakey.
sentence_translations.translation: 这似乎并没有困扰艾灵顿、戴维斯和布莱基这样的人。

sentence_translations.sentence: Their attitude was 'the music comes first'.
sentence_translations.translation: 他们的态度是‘音乐至上’。

sentence_translations.sentence: The moments of musical genius when everything came together excused minor problems such as if individuals occasionally turned up late for practice, or stepped out of a performance for a quick snack.
sentence_translations.translation: 当一切融为一体时展现出的音乐天才时刻，使得诸如个别成员偶尔排练迟到、或在演出中途溜出去吃点零食之类的小问题变得情有可原。

sentence_translations.sentence: Teams must coordinate their behaviour and action to achieve an outcome.
sentence_translations.translation: 团队必须协调其行为和行动才能达成成果。

sentence_translations.sentence: The team leader can assume a number of different roles when helping the team achieve its objectives.
sentence_translations.translation: 团队领导在帮助团队实现目标时可以扮演多种不同的角色。

sentence_translations.sentence: Some leaders are very directive, detailing what tasks they want team members to perform, and how they want them to go about those tasks.
sentence_translations.translation: 有些领导非常指令性强，详细说明他们希望团队成员执行哪些任务，以及希望他们如何开展这些任务。

sentence_translations.sentence: But that was not the approach Ellington, Davis and Blakey adopted.
sentence_translations.translation: 但这并不是埃林顿、戴维斯和布莱基所采用的方法。

sentence_translations.sentence: Instead, these leaders acted more as facilitators, empowering the musicians to collectively coordinate their behaviour and action to produce the desired outcome.
sentence_translations.translation: 相反，这些领导者更像促进者，授权音乐家们共同协调自身的行为和行动，以产生理想的结果。

sentence_translations.sentence: As Ucbasaran and Lockett note, Miles Davis discouraged band members from rehearsing in case it led to musical clichés from over-practice.
sentence_translations.translation: 正如乌克巴萨兰和洛基特所指出的，迈尔斯·戴维斯不鼓励乐队成员排练，以防过度练习导致音乐上的陈词滥调。

sentence_translations.sentence: Similarly, he often asked his musicians to play a piece in an unusual key, so they did not rely on learned fingering patterns.
sentence_translations.translation: 同样，他经常要求他的音乐家们用不寻常的调式演奏一首曲子，使他们不依赖于习得的指法模式。

sentence_translations.sentence: The performers were not left entirely to their own devices though.
sentence_translations.translation: 不过，表演者并非完全放任自流。

sentence_translations.sentence: All three leaders created a general framework within which team members could work, providing guidance but also the freedom to explore, express and make mistakes.
sentence_translations.translation: 三位领导者都建立了一个总体的框架，团队成员可以在其中工作，既提供指导，也给予探索、表达和犯错的自由。

sentence_translations.sentence: The third aspect of leadership behaviour that Ucbasaran and her colleagues looked at was managing team turnover - people joining and leaving the team.
sentence_translations.translation: Ucbasaran 及其同事研究的领导行为的第三个方面是管理团队更替——即团队成员的加入与离开。

sentence_translations.sentence: in the jazz ensembles studied, musicians joined and left on a regular basis.
sentence_translations.translation: 在所研究的爵士乐团中，音乐家们定期加入和离开。

sentence_translations.sentence: Yet the high turnover of team members, despite the resulting loss of knowledge and skills, was seen in a positive light.
sentence_translations.translation: 然而，尽管团队成员的频繁更替导致了知识和技能的流失，这仍被以积极的眼光看待。

sentence_translations.sentence: That was partly because of the advantages of getting a fresh shot of knowledge, ideas and creativity when new members joined.
sentence_translations.translation: 这部分是因为新成员加入时带来的新知识、新想法和新创造力的优势。

sentence_translations.sentence: A common reason for the jazz musicians leaving was that they felt sufficiently qualified to go and run another band.
sentence_translations.translation: 爵士乐手离开的一个常见原因是他们感到自己足够有资格去经营另一支乐队。

sentence_translations.sentence: The three band leaders were understanding about this, particularly as it was a process they had also been through.
sentence_translations.translation: 三位乐队领袖对此表示理解，尤其是因为这也是他们曾经经历过的过程。

sentence_translations.sentence: In some cases, in particular with Art Blakey, they actively encouraged and coached team members to become leaders.
sentence_translations.translation: 在某些情况下，特别是阿特·布雷基，他们积极鼓励并指导团队成员成为领导者。

sentence_translations.sentence: As the jazz icons Ellington, Davis and Blakey would no doubt agree, there is no magic score that if followed note by note will make you a great leader of creative talent.
sentence_translations.translation: 正如爵士乐偶像埃林顿、戴维斯和布雷基无疑会认同的那样，并不存在一个神奇的乐谱，只要逐音遵循就能让你成为创造性人才的伟大领导者。

sentence_translations.sentence: However, take an entrepreneur, a few cues from the aforementioned jazz trio, mix in a little improvisation, and you are more likely to hear the sweet sound of success.
sentence_translations.translation: 然而，如果一位企业家从上述爵士三人组中汲取一些经验，再融入一点即兴发挥，你就更有可能听到成功的甜美声音。

sentence_translations.sentence: As Louis Armstrong once sang: 'Now that's jazz'.
sentence_translations.translation: 正如路易斯·阿姆斯特朗曾唱道：'这就是爵士乐'。
